Chapter 1385 - 7: Lin Yuan’S Influence

Chapter 1385: Chapter 7: Lin Yuan’s Influence

The Heart of Heavenly River appears in a pale purple color, faintly transmitting the sound of the Milky Way’s surging.

It seems like a ’miniature’ version of the Milky Way.

Lin Yuan carefully observes the Heart of Heavenly River in his hand.

It is the gathering of origin power from the Milky Way dimension, but this Heart of Heavenly River contains more than just origin power.

There are also some deeper breaths.

Because of the latter, the Heart of Heavenly River, a Thirteenth Grade First Realm treasure, has swiftly become a Third Realm lord-level material.

Third Realm lord-level material is enough to attract the eyes of many Second Realm time lifeforms, such as the Gray Ancestor who was just repelled by Lin Yuan.

"This Heart of Heavenly River can be used to refine the body, allowing me to enhance my physique strength by forty percent."

Lin Yuan thought to himself, as a Third Realm material, it has an effect even on true Time Lords.

The strength of Lin Yuan’s physical body surpasses many Second Realm time lifeforms specializing in physical enhancements, yet he can still enhance his physique strength by forty percent.

It is conceivable how precious this Heart of Heavenly River is.

At Lin Yuan’s level, even a tiny increment in physique growth is a breakthrough.

Enhancing by forty percent all at once?

It’s not a matter of time, but of overcoming bottlenecks.

"And the Milky Way..."

Lin Yuan shifts his gaze, looking at the vast Milky Way dimension.

With the aid of this Heart of Heavenly River, Lin Yuan can directly perceive the rules of the Milky Way dimension’s Dao operation.

It’s akin to observing the source world’s origin operation up close without any time constraints.

In the Chaos Void dimension, there exists numerous natural universes, nurturing countless life.

And the Milky Way dimension also exists as numerous worlds, appearing as a vast Milky Way.

In reality, every drop of river water is a world, comparable to the natural universes in the Chaos Void.

Of course.

Unlike the Chaos Void.

The Milky Way dimension essentially provides no protection for these river water worlds.

External time lifeforms can destroy as many drops of river water worlds as they desire.

But in the Chaos Void? External time lifeforms can’t even enter.

As for native time lifeforms? They would not deliberately go to destroy one after another natural universe.

Native time lifeforms attempting to completely destroy a natural universe and sever its chance for rebirth.

Would also suffer the backlash of the Chaos Void.

"The operation of the origin Dao in this dimensional space does not help me as much as the source world."

Lin Yuan quietly thinks after sensing for a while.

One reason is that the Milky Way dimension is inferior to the source world, and naturally, the operation of the origin Dao cannot compare.

Another reason is the Milky Way dimension is not far from the Chaos Void, and their origin Dao operations have some similarities.

This is why many time lifeforms want to explore the far territories between dimensions.

To witness the essence of origin operation different from their hometown dimensional space, which deeply influences themselves.

"But it still has some utility."

Lin Yuan does not complain.

A small mosquito is still meat.

Especially since as a top-dimensional space operation essence, it is exceedingly precious for time lifeforms.

Don’t look at how easily Lin Yuan obtained this Heart of Heavenly River, without any difficulty.

This is because of Lin Yuan’s strength.

Ordinary First Realm time lifeforms often seek the Heart of Heavenly River in vain.

Even the seven time lifeforms in Chaos Void dimension had to wait ’in line’ for countless years to qualify for gaining a Heart of Heavenly River.

Other First Realm time lifeforms? Without teamwork, there is basically no chance.

"At my current level, I can comprehend it fully within a hundred years."

Lin Yuan pondered briefly and reached a conclusion.

With the assistance of the Heart of Heavenly River, at most a hundred years, he could completely comprehend the operation of the Dao Origin in the Milky Way dimension.

...

The Milky Way dimension.

Many time lifeforms watch Lin Yuan from a distance.

Just now, having fought against the Gray Ancestor, Lin Yuan has already demonstrated his strength.

Even among Second Realm time lifeforms, it counts as powerful strength.

Thirteenth Grade is divided into three tiers; masters of the third tier generally have pursuits, seeking the path to transcendence.

Therefore, Second Realm time lifeforms can mostly roam the vast dimensional crevices.

This Milky Way dimension is divided among a group of First Realm time lifeforms, balancing each other.

But if a Second Realm time lifeform develops an interest, it could completely drive them out.

Occupying the entire Milky Way dimension alone.

So now many time lifeforms are a bit worried.

They do not know what Lin Yuan intends to do next.

...

The nine time lifeforms of Taixu dimension look somewhat heavy.

The cost of offending a Second Realm time lifeform seems too great for them.

It can be foreseen that if the issue with Lin Yuan is not resolved, in the coming years, every time lifeform in the Taixu dimension would not dare continue exploring the vast dimensional crevices.

The Master of Taixu gathers his thoughts and immediately stops not far away from Lin Yuan.

"We were driven by Gray Ancestor..."

The Master of Taixu lowers his stance, seeking Lin Yuan’s ’forgiveness.’

"Merely driven?"

Lin Yuan glanced at the Master of Taixu.

The strength of Second Realm time lifeforms indeed overshadows the First Realm, which is true.

But to drive a First Realm time lifeform? That’s completely unrealistic.

Can’t fight, but can’t hide?

How many life-saving methods do time lifeforms have? To completely kill a First Realm time lifeform, only a lord has assurance.

As for the Second Realm?

Really forced, at worst, just stay hidden in their hometown dimensional space.
